name: private_overload_beside_export_rt
description: bug-912: a PRIVATE overload beside a PUBLIC/EXPORT overload of the same name file-scopes only the PRIVATE declaration. The PUBLIC one stays callable from other files, the EXPORT one stays in the package's export table, and inside the declaring file a call selects among both by argument type. Also pins the two neighbours that must not move: two files each declaring `PRIVATE FUNC helper()` do not collide, and a PRIVATE in one file still hides another file's PUBLIC of that name within its own file.
